claims.content: To unlock a customer's account from 'Review Status' so they can bid again after resolving non-payment issues.

goal.raw_text: To unlock a customer's account from 'Review Status' so they can bid again after resolving non-payment issues.

claims.content: Customer Service Representative
The customer's account is currently in 'Review Status' due to unresolved (unpaid) auction winnings.
The customer has contacted the call center regarding their locked account or cancelled orders.
The Customer Service Representative has verified that the customer has not exceeded the limit of three unpaid orders (unless the rate is below 10%).
A customer contacts the call center regarding their locked account or cancelled orders.

trigger.raw_text: A customer contacts the call center regarding their locked account or cancelled orders.

claims.content: The Customer Service Representative accesses the customer's account which is in 'Review Status'.

The Customer Service Representative verifies that the customer has not failed to pay for auction winnings more than three times in a twelve-month period, or confirms that such failures constitute less than 10% of their total winnings.
The Customer Service Representative unlocks the customer's account from 'Review Status'.
The Customer Service Representative reminds the customer that winning an auction incurs an obligation to pay.
If the customer has failed to pay for auction winnings more than three times in a twelve-month period and this constitutes 10% or more of their total winnings, the escalation policy is applied.
Under the escalation policy, the Customer Service Representative cannot remove the account from Review Status until the customer updates their account with a credit card.
The customer may not use PayPal or Amazon Payments again until their order cancel rate falls below 10%.

If the customer's account is in 'Review Status' due to an expired PayPal or Amazon Payments order, the Customer Service Representative cannot unlock the account by having the customer pay for the orders, as these orders are automatically cancelled after 7 days (168 hours).
If the customer has had orders cancelled and has not paid up to three times, the Customer Service Representative can unlock their account upon contact.

If the customer fails to pay for auction winnings more than three times in a twelve-month period, and this constitutes 10% or more of their total winnings, they are subject to the escalation policy and cannot have their account removed from Review Status until they update their account with a credit card.
The customer's account is removed from 'Review Status' and they are allowed to bid again.
The customer has been reminded that winning an auction incurs an obligation to pay.
